source.bulkDescription: A JSON file containing one Scryfall card object for each Oracle ID on Scryfall. The chosen sets for the cards are an attempt to return the most up-to-date recognizable version of the card.

selectionPolicy.sort: English card name, then Oracle ID
selectionPolicy.note: Every non-reminder Oracle line must exactly match a central keyword or a closed executable template. Prefix/partial autoscripting is never certification.
